title: Interactive Partner Filtering
summary: Build filters to view case studies by partner type, industry, company size, and use case category
findings: Post-launch enhancement. Useful when case study library grows beyond 5-10 partners. Early analytics needed to validate user behavior - do visitors browse all cases or seek specific types? Similar features on competitor sites show moderate engagement (15-30% of visitors use filters).
opportunity_driver: Improves user experience with large case study libraries
Reduces bounce rate when visitor seeks specific industries
dependencies: Minimum 8-10 case studies to justify filtering
Taxonomy for partner types and industries
next_steps: Monitor analytics post-launch to validate need. Survey 10-15 early visitors about discovery preferences. Prototype filter UI if >30% users view 3+ case studies.

title: Downloadable PDF One-Pager
summary: Generate export-ready PDF overview for offline sharing at conferences, sales meetings, and partnership discussions
findings: Nice-to-have for enterprise sales cycles. Partners often request leave-behind materials. Implementation relatively straightforward using browser print CSS or server-side PDF generation. Value uncertain until we measure download rates.
opportunity_driver: Offline sharing at conferences and events
next_steps: Gather feedback from partnerships team on collateral needs. Estimate download demand based on similar assets. Prototype print CSS and test across browsers.

title: Embedded Video/Testimonial
summary: Add partner testimonial video or animation explaining the Software Factory pipeline and AI Studio capabilities
findings: Exploratory. Video increases engagement but adds production cost and page load time. Competitor analysis shows mixed results - some partner pages have video (40-60s view time average), others purely static. Need to weigh engagement gain vs. production effort and performance impact.
opportunity_driver: Increases engagement and time on page
Humanizes the brand with partner voice
dependencies: Partner willing to provide video testimonial
Lazy loading implementation to preserve page speed
next_steps: Survey partners about testimonial willingness. Estimate video production cost (internal vs. agency). A/B test static vs. video on similar page to measure impact. Prototype lazy-load video player.

title: Post-Launch A/B Testing
summary: Plan experiments for hero headline copy, CTA button text, and workflow timeline visualization to optimize conversion rates
findings: Standard post-launch optimization. Typical A/B tests show 10-30% conversion lift with headline/CTA optimization. Requires minimum traffic volume (1000+ visitors/month) for statistical significance. Should prioritize based on analytics - test high-traffic, low-conversion areas first.
opportunity_driver: Optimize conversion rate for contact form and calendar bookings
Validate messaging effectiveness with real data
Continuous improvement based on user behavior
dependencies: A/B testing platform (Optimizely, VWO, or custom)
Sufficient traffic volume for statistical significance
Variant ideas based on initial analytics
next_steps: Set up A/B testing framework at launch. Monitor initial conversion rates for 2-4 weeks. Identify high-impact test opportunities (hero, CTA, proof section). Run first test when traffic >1000/month.
